utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’m still lining up the Saturday porch repair drive, so any help you can bring would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll be there Saturday at the porch and I’ll bring a few supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — quick update, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still lining up a few helpers there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks for the update — I’ll switch it to Sunday at the community center and keep rounding up a couple more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the front porch repair drive Saturday—just remind me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It moved to Sunday at the community center—can you still make it, and do you have simple tools and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a quick update, Pia: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m still lining up a few extra helpers. If you need, I can help spread the word and remind folks to bring simple tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center helps a lot. I’ll keep gathering a few more helpers and send the exact time as soon as I have it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina — I’m still lining up the Saturday porch repair drive, and any help you can bring would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help Saturday on the front porch. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still organizing the Saturday front porch repair drive, and I could really use a few more helpers. I’ll try to round up a couple more people too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep recruiting a few more helpers for Saturday at the front porch too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — we moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send you the new time soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center now. Just send me the new time and I’ll be there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
